caption: The drawing depicts a wooden humanoid figure standing upright against a plain, light background. The figure has an elongated body and limbs, with a rounded head on top. The colors used are predominantly dark brown, reddish-brown, black, and off-white. The face of the figure is off-white with black details for the eyes, eyebrows, and nose, and red for the mouth and cheeks, set within a black outline. The upper body and arms are dark brown, with the front of the torso being off-white bordered by reddish-brown lines, and adorned with three red buttons down the chest area. The arms are long and dark brown, extending downward, with rectangular extensions near the hands that are colored in shades transitioning from dark brown to reddish and beige. The figure's legs are long and slightly apart, primarily off-white in the thigh area and dark brown in the lower sections, with red horizontal bands around the knees and upper boots, and black at the feet and boots. There is a horizontal metal or gray strap connecting the figure’s feet. The figure stands alone with no other objects or background elements in the composition.
title: Whirligig
